Aulic Council.question: The _____ was One of the two supreme courts of the Holy Roman Empire (1498-1806).
Aulic Council.fact: The Aulic Council (Latin: Consilium Aulicum; German: Reichshofrat; literally 'Court Council of the Empire', sometimes abbreviated in academic writing as "RHR") was one of the two supreme courts of the Holy Roman Empire, the other being the Reichskammergericht (Imperial Chamber Court). Aulic Council.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts

Aulic Council.fact: Unlike the Reichskammergericht, which was tied to the Imperial estates, the Aulic Council was tied directly to the Emperor. It had not only concurrent jurisdiction with the Reichskammergericht, but in many cases exclusive jurisdiction: the Aulic Council had exclusive jurisdiction in all "feudal" processes, and in criminal affairs, over the immediate subjects of the Emperor and in affairs which concerned the Empire, and more (see Responsibilities section below).

Baháʼí cosmology.question: He views all metaphysical viewpoints as relative, reflecting only the soul or psyche and cultural background of the individual rather than any _____
Baháʼí cosmology.fact: He views all metaphysical viewpoints as relative, reflecting only the soul or psyche and cultural background of the individual rather than any Absolute Truth.

Baháʼí cosmology.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Baháʼí cosmology.question: God is manifested in all five realms, the _____ of God in all but the first realm, and humans exist between the angelic and physical realms and can choose which to live in
Baháʼí cosmology.fact: God is manifested in all five realms, the Manifestations of God in all but the first realm, and humans exist between the angelic and physical realms and can choose which to live in.

Baháʼí cosmology.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Baháʼí cosmology.question: The realms of Nasut and _____ are parts of the 'world of creation' and are ruled by the same spiritual laws
Baháʼí cosmology.fact: The realms of Nasut and Malakut are parts of the 'world of creation' and are ruled by the same spiritual laws. Man has a free will to live a material life in the world of Nasut, or a life of detachment in the realm of Malakut, manifesting the names and attributes of God.

Baháʼí cosmology.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Baháʼí cosmology.question: Before the _____ of God is revealed, all people are considered equal in rank
Baháʼí cosmology.fact: Before the Word of God is revealed, all people are considered equal in rank.

Baháʼí cosmology.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Baháʼí cosmology.question: Differences only appear after the _____ reveals himself, caused by the different responses of each individual's free will
Baháʼí cosmology.fact: Baháʼu'lláh explains that the 'realm of subtle entities' (ʻalam-i-dharr, a reference to God's primordial covenant with humanity mentioned in Qurʼán 7:172[Quran 7:172]) refers to the revelation of the Prophets. Differences only appear after the Prophet reveals himself, caused by the different responses of each individual's free will.

Baháʼí cosmology.subject: Courts Cases & Verdicts
Baháʼí cosmology.question: In the Súriy-i-_____, he writes: "Know thou of a truth that the worlds of God are countless in their number, and infinite in their range
Baháʼí cosmology.fact: In the Súriy-i-Vafa, he writes: "Know thou of a truth that the worlds of God are countless in their number, and infinite in their range.
